title: How often a body part ends closer to its ordered orientation 250 ms after the order, out of 100
question: When an order tells a body part (a wrist, an elbow, a finger...) to turn to a new orientation, is the part closer to that orientation 250 ms later (the time an order is held: 5 model steps x 5 physics ticks of 10 ms) than it was when the order was given? Closer = the angle between the part's world orientation and the ordered world orientation is smaller after 250 ms than at the order. Counted per part per order.
scale: 0 of 100 = no part ever ends closer; 100 of 100 = every part always ends closer. The chance line is the count the same real 250 ms turns reach against a target at the same distance in a random direction (the order ignored).

chance_order_ignored.why_not_50: A turn about as large as the distance to the target lands closer to a randomly placed target about 1 time in 4 (exactly 25 in 100 for equal sizes in the small-angle limit); 50 holds only for turns much smaller than the distance. The live parts turned a median 13.7 degrees against a median ordered distance of 23.8 degrees.

live_by_author_labels.planner: the planner's first action (lem_model last_action_source 'planner'; no babble is added to it)
live_by_author_labels.reflex_noise: the motor controller's output with babble added (babble noise 0.05, during a babble bout)
live_by_author_labels.reflex: the motor controller's output alone (between babble bouts, babble 0)

distance_closed_in_250ms.note: How much of the ordered distance was closed: pooled = (sum of distances before - sum after) / sum before; median = median of each part-order's share. Negative = ended farther away.

physics_only_as_whole_body_following_is_.note: whole_body_following.py exactly as written (row n-1 = chest left unordered, the gaze row ordered); counts over the 24 parts it orders
physics_only_as_whole_body_following_is_.read_as_goal_line: never: measured on the gauge that took the last row, the chest, for the eyes (env.py before commit b55ee9a4d); lineage_series reads physics_only_on_the_repaired_gauge

physics_only_on_the_repaired_gauge.note: tools/whole_body_following.py on the repaired gauge (commit b55ee9a4d and later): the eyes' row found by name and left out, the chest ordered and scored, each order read over exactly its own 25 frames. lineage_series reads its goal lines from this case only (fix-rows-r2-lineage_series, 2026-09-23).
physics_only_on_the_repaired_gauge.code_note: HEAD when each run ended. env.py, tools/whole_body_following.py, action_decoder.py, tools/command_following.py, body_layout.py and lem/model/body_sets.py are the same in c90a758f4 (03:38, before the runs began) and in every commit named here, and had no uncommitted edits.
physics_only_on_the_repaired_gauge.scale: Each reading is the env gauge's averaged cosine over the scored parts: -1 = every part turned exactly against its order, 0 = the turn is unrelated to the order, +1 = exactly as ordered. The pages show it as a percentage of the way from 'unrelated' to 'exactly as ordered'.
physics_only_on_the_repaired_gauge.method: tools/whole_body_following.run's loop, unchanged: one body in the crib, vision off, mechanical_v4, age 24, decoder gain 6, cmd_horizon 25, strength 0.5, 20-degree turns, each order held 25 ticks (250 ms), trials alternating a posture the body really reached (reachable_pose, the tool's 'consistent' orders: three unchained parts driven for 40 ticks, every part's pose there recorded, 60 ticks back at rest, then one order to that pose) and every part but the eyes turned 20 degrees about its own random axis (independent_turns). 4 processes, seeds 0, 1, 2, 3, 100 trials each. Read beside the tool's own reading, with no change to the physics: held_250ms = env.py cmd_response_slow.cos on the hold's last tick (the tool's reading; the trainer logs it as cmd_response_cos_held on an order's last model step); one_frame_10ms = env.py cmd_response.cos on ticks 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 of the hold, the last frame of each 5-frame model step, averaged per order (the frames train_mimo's follow_bout averages, in bouts); parts_scored = every part the gauge scored on at least one order, by name (strength above 0, not the eyes' row, an ordered turn of at least 1e-4 rad), checked against the gauge's own count on every order. Intervals resample whole orders (2,000 resamples). Seed 0 reproduces whole_body_following.run(6, 0.5, 100, 20, 0) on the same code to the last digit (identity_check).
physics_only_on_the_repaired_gauge.differences_from_the_live_world: As the other physics cases (see uncertainty): no caregiver, mobile or critters, body_function off, fixed strength 0.5, fixed 20-degree turns, each order from rest with no babble and no blend toward the previous order.

scripts.measure:
"""Physics-only following references on the repaired gauge, for lineage_series' goal lines.

The loop is tools/whole_body_following.run exactly as committed at b55ee9a4d and later (same world:
crib, vision off, mechanical_v4, age 24, decoder gain 6, cmd_horizon 25; same DRIVERS, rest_order,
_turn, strength 0.5, 20-degree turns, 25-tick hold; same scene tag; trials alternate reachable pose
and independent turns). Nothing changes the physics; three things are read beside the tool's own
reading:

1. the tool's reading: env.py cmd_response_slow.cos on the hold's last tick (the 250 ms held gauge
   that the trainer logs as cmd_response_cos_held on an order's last model step), with its scored
   part count n;
2. the parts that gauge scored, BY NAME: every row with strength above 0, not the eyes' row (found
   by name), whose ordered turn is at least 1e-4 rad (env.py _command_response's own lines). The
   list's length is checked against the gauge's n on every trial;
3. the one-frame gauge, env.py cmd_response.cos (10 ms), read the way train_mimo samples follow_bout:
   the last frame of each 5-frame model step, ticks 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 of the hold, averaged per
   order; also its mean over every tick.

usage: python follow_anchor_measure.py <trials> <seed> <out.json>   (run with the cwd where the scene
files may be written; the tool writes them under ./Saved/mimo_bridge/scenes_test)"""
import json
import math
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "-1"
import numpy as np

import mimo_bridge
from mimo_bridge.action_decoder import quat_xyzw_to_mat, rotmat_log
from mimo_bridge.body_layout import names_for
from mimo_bridge.env import BridgeEnv
from mimo_bridge.tools import whole_body_following as W
from mimo_bridge.tools.command_following import _turn, rest_order

TRIALS, SEED, OUT = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
KP, STRENGTH, ANGLE, HOLD, MODEL_STEP_FRAMES = 6.0, 0.5, 20.0, 25, 5


def scored_parts(env, order, xq0, names, gaze):
    """The rows env.py _command_response scores for this order and start pose, by name."""
    out = []
    for i in range(len(names)):
        if i == gaze or order[i, 8] <= 0:
            continue
        q0 = xq0[i]
        R0 = quat_xyzw_to_mat([q0[1], q0[2], q0[3], q0[0]])
        if np.linalg.norm(rotmat_log(quat_xyzw_to_mat(order[i, 3:7]) @ R0.T)) < 1e-4:
            continue
        out.append(names[i])
    return out


def main():
    names = list(names_for("trunk_v1"))
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    env = BridgeEnv(scene="crib", run_dir=os.path.join("Saved", "mimo_bridge", "scenes_test"), vision=False,
                    tag=f"_wholebody_{KP:g}_{STRENGTH:g}", age=24, contact_profile="mechanical_v4",
                    caregiver_seconds=0, kp=KP, body_layout="trunk_v1", cmd_horizon=HOLD)
    assert list(env.proprio.handle_names) == names, env.proprio.handle_names
    rows = []
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        env.reset()
        n = len(names)
        gaze = names.index("gaze")
        for _ in range(20):
            env.step(rest_order(env, n), None, None, render=False)
        for t in range(TRIALS):
            kind = "consistent" if t % 2 == 0 else "independent"
            if kind == "consistent":
                drive = rest_order(env, n)
                for group in W.DRIVERS:
                    h = group[int(rng.integers(len(group)))]
                    i = names.index(h)
                    drive[i, 3:7] = _turn(drive[i, 3:7], rng.normal(size=3), math.radians(ANGLE))
                    drive[i, 8] = STRENGTH
                for _ in range(40):
                    env.step(drive, None, None, render=False)
                target = rest_order(env, n)
                for _ in range(60):
                    env.step(rest_order(env, n), None, None, render=False)
                order = target.copy()
            else:
                order = rest_order(env, n)
                for i in range(n):
                    if i != gaze:
                        order[i, 3:7] = _turn(order[i, 3:7], rng.normal(size=3), math.radians(ANGLE))
            order[:, 8] = STRENGTH
            order[gaze, 8] = 0.0
            xq0 = np.array([env.data.xquat[b] for b in env.proprio.body_ids[:n]])
            parts = scored_parts(env, order, xq0, names, gaze)
            held = None
            frame_samples, frame_all = [], []
            for k in range(HOLD):
                out = env.step(order, None, None, render=False)
                one = (out.info.get("cmd_response") or {}).get("cos")
                if one is not None:
                    frame_all.append(float(one))
                    if (k + 1) % MODEL_STEP_FRAMES == 0:
                        frame_samples.append(float(one))
                cr = out.info.get("cmd_response_slow")
                if cr and cr.get("cos") is not None and k == HOLD - 1:
                    held = (float(cr["cos"]), float(cr.get("ratio", 0.0)), int(cr.get("n", 0)))
            wcos, mag = W._weighted_cos(env, order, xq0, names)
            if held is not None:
                assert held[2] == len(parts), (t, held[2], parts)
            rows.append(dict(kind=kind, trial=t, held_cos=held[0] if held else None,
                             held_ratio=held[1] if held else None, held_n=held[2] if held else None,
                             parts=parts, weighted_cos=wcos, mean_turn_deg=math.degrees(mag),
                             one_frame_samples=frame_samples,
                             one_frame_as_follow_bout=float(np.mean(frame_samples)) if frame_samples else None,
                             one_frame_every_tick=float(np.mean(frame_all)) if frame_all else None))
            for _ in range(60):
                env.step(rest_order(env, n), None, None, render=False)
            if t % 10 == 0:
                print(f"seed {SEED} trial {t} {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
    finally:
        env.close()
    root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(mimo_bridge.__file__)))
    head = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", root, "status", "--porcelain", "--", "mimo_bridge/env.py",
                            "mimo_bridge/tools/whole_body_following.py", "mimo_bridge/action_decoder.py",
                            "mimo_bridge/tools/command_following.py"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(dict(kp=KP, strength=STRENGTH, angle_deg=ANGLE, hold_ticks=HOLD, seed=SEED, trials=TRIALS,
                       layout="trunk_v1", names=names, source=os.path.abspath(mimo_bridge.__file__),
                       commit=head, gauge_files_uncommitted=dirty, seconds=round(time.time() - t0, 1),
                       rows=rows), f)
    print("done", OUT, flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
scripts.analyse:
"""Combine the per-seed runs of follow_anchor_measure.py into the stored case (printed as JSON).

Per arm (reachable pose = whole_body_following's 'consistent' orders; independent turns): the mean of
the 250 ms held reading and of the one-frame reading sampled as follow_bout samples it, each with a
95% interval from resampling whole orders (2,000 resamples, rng seed 7), halves (seeds 0-1 against
2-3, and first against second half of each seed's orders) and the per-seed means; the parts the gauge
scored, by name, and how many per order. Also checks seed 0 against the tool's own run() output on
the same seed (rowfix/fg_run/new100.json) when that file exists."""
import json
import os
import sys

import numpy as np

S = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
seeds = [int(x) for x in sys.argv[1].split(",")]
runs = {s: json.load(open(os.path.join(S, "anchor_run", f"seed{s}.json"), encoding="utf-8")) for s in seeds}
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)


def ci(values, reps=2000):
    v = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    idx = rng.integers(len(v), size=(reps, len(v)))
    m = v[idx].mean(1)
    return [round(float(np.percentile(m, 2.5)), 4), round(float(np.percentile(m, 97.5)), 4)]


def arm(kind):
    rows = [(s, r) for s in seeds for r in runs[s]["rows"] if r["kind"] == kind]
    out = {}
    for key, name in (("held_cos", "held_250ms"), ("one_frame_as_follow_bout", "one_frame_10ms")):
        vals = [r[key] for _, r in rows if r[key] is not None]
        first = [r[key] for s, r in rows if r[key] is not None and s in seeds[:len(seeds) // 2]]
        second = [r[key] for s, r in rows if r[key] is not None and s in seeds[len(seeds) // 2:]]
        per_seed = {str(s): round(float(np.mean([r[key] for s2, r in rows if s2 == s and r[key] is not None])), 4)
                    for s in seeds}
        n_half = {s: len([1 for s2, _ in rows if s2 == s]) // 2 for s in seeds}
        early, late = [], []
        seen = {s: 0 for s in seeds}
        for s, r in rows:
            if r[key] is None:
                continue
            (early if seen[s] < n_half[s] else late).append(r[key])
            seen[s] += 1
        out[name + "_mean"] = round(float(np.mean(vals)), 4)
        out[name] = dict(mean=round(float(np.mean(vals)), 4), orders=len(vals), interval_95pct=ci(vals),
                         halves_by_seed=[round(float(np.mean(first)), 4), round(float(np.mean(second)), 4)],
                         halves_by_time=[round(float(np.mean(early)), 4), round(float(np.mean(late)), 4)],
                         per_seed=per_seed)
    counts = [len(r["parts"]) for _, r in rows]
    out["parts_per_order"] = dict(min=min(counts), max=max(counts), mean=round(float(np.mean(counts)), 2))
    out["commanded_turn_deg_mean"] = round(float(np.mean([r["mean_turn_deg"] for _, r in rows])), 2)
    out["one_frame_every_tick_mean"] = round(float(np.mean([r["one_frame_every_tick"] for _, r in rows
                                                            if r["one_frame_every_tick"] is not None])), 4)
    return out, rows


reach, rrows = arm("consistent")
ind, irows = arm("independent")
names = runs[seeds[0]]["names"]
scored = [n for n in names if any(n in r["parts"] for _, r in rrows + irows)]
check = {}
p = os.path.join(S, "fg_run", "new100.json")
if 0 in runs and os.path.isfile(p) and runs[0]["trials"] == 100:
    tool = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
    mine = {k: float(np.mean([r["held_cos"] for r in runs[0]["rows"] if r["kind"] == k and r["held_cos"] is not None]))
            for k in ("consistent", "independent")}
    check = dict(tool_run_seed0=dict(consistent=tool["consistent"]["direction_match_mean"],
                                     independent=tool["independent"]["direction_match_mean"]),
                 this_loop_seed0=mine,
                 identical=all(abs(mine[k] - tool[k]["direction_match_mean"]) < 1e-12 for k in mine))
print(json.dumps(dict(seeds=seeds, trials_per_seed={str(s): runs[s]["trials"] for s in seeds},
                      commits={str(s): runs[s]["commit"] for s in seeds},
                      gauge_files_uncommitted={str(s): runs[s]["gauge_files_uncommitted"] for s in seeds},
                      seconds={str(s): runs[s]["seconds"] for s in seeds},
                      layout=runs[seeds[0]]["layout"], parts_scored=scored, reachable_pose=reach,
                      independent_turns=ind, identity_check=check), indent=1))

scripts.live:
"""Case 1: the live model's own latched orders. For each latched order and each body part with
strength > 0 (gaze row skipped): is the part closer to the ordered world orientation 250 ms
later (at the next latch) than it was at the latch? Also the chance count: the part's real
250 ms turn scored against random targets of the same distance."""
import os, sys, json, time, math
from pathlib import Path
os.environ.setdefault("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "-1")
import numpy as np
import torch

from mimo_bridge.tools import gof_probe_harness as H

SCRATCH = Path(sys.argv[1])
STEPS = int(sys.argv[2])            # model steps per body
BODIES = [int(x) for x in sys.argv[3].split(",")]
OUT = SCRATCH / sys.argv[4]
CKPT = r"D:\UEMA_Research\Saved\mimo_bridge\experiments\H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg31_toy_and_push\checkpoints\ckpt_step_344400"
H.PROBES_ROOT = SCRATCH / "probe_root"          # the sessions' scene folders go to scratch
N_RAND = 200
rng = np.random.default_rng(12345)


def qmul(a, b):
    return H.quat_mul_xyzw(a, b)


def chance_share(q0, q1, d0_deg):
    """Share of random targets (q0 turned d0 degrees about a uniformly random world axis) that
    q1 is closer to than q0 was (q0's distance to each is d0 by construction)."""
    axes = rng.normal(size=(N_RAND, 3))
    hits = 0
    for ax in axes:
        qt = qmul(H.axis_angle_xyzw(ax, d0_deg), q0)
        if H.rotation_deg_xyzw(q1, qt) < d0_deg:
            hits += 1
    return hits / N_RAND


def rotvec_cos(q0, qt, q1):
    from mimo_bridge.action_decoder import quat_xyzw_to_mat, rotmat_log
    R0, Rt, R1 = quat_xyzw_to_mat(q0), quat_xyzw_to_mat(qt), quat_xyzw_to_mat(q1)
    wc, wg = rotmat_log(Rt @ R0.T), rotmat_log(R1 @ R0.T)
    nc, ng = np.linalg.norm(wc), np.linalg.norm(wg)
    if nc < 1e-4:
        return None
    return float(np.dot(wc, wg) / (nc * ng)) if ng > 1e-6 else 0.0


t_all = time.time()
fz = H.load_frozen(CKPT, threads=4)
ep, note = H.load_episode(fz)
print("episode:", note, flush=True)
babble = float(getattr(fz.args, "babble_noise", 0.0) or 0.0)
BOUTS = str(getattr(fz.args, "babble_bouts", "off")) in ("on", "real") and not bool(getattr(fz.args, "no_babble", False))
_st0 = ep["trainer"]
print("bout state at save:", _st0.get("bout_on"), _st0.get("bout_until"), _st0.get("step"), "bouts", BOUTS, flush=True)
result = dict(checkpoint=CKPT, episode_note=note, babble=babble, steps_per_body=STEPS, bodies={}, rows=[])
for b in BODIES:
    t0 = time.time()
    s = H.Session(fz, episode=ep, body=b, babble=babble)
    env = s.env
    dec_ids = [h.body_id for h in env.decoder.handles]
    prop_ids = [int(x) for x in env.proprio.body_ids]
    assert dec_ids == prop_ids, (dec_ids, prop_ids)
    assert abs(s.clock.held_order_seconds - 0.25) < 1e-9, s.clock.held_order_seconds
    names = s.handle_names
    gi = s.gaze_idx
    # THE TRAINER'S BABBLE BOUTS (train_mimo.py, before model.step): babble on for 2-5 s, off for
    # 1-3 s, one schedule for all bodies, restored from the episode's saved schedule state
    st = ep["trainer"]
    bout_on, bout_until = bool(st["bout_on"]), int(st["bout_until"])
    bout_rng = np.random.default_rng()
    bout_rng.bit_generator.state = st["bout_rng"]
    tsec = float(s.clock.model_step_seconds)
    bout_steps = {True: 0, False: 0}
    pending = None
    latches = 0
    sources = {}
    try:
        for k in range(STEPS):
            step = s._policy_i
            if BOUTS:
                if step >= bout_until:
                    bout_on = not bout_on
                    dur_s = bout_rng.uniform(2.0, 5.0) if bout_on else bout_rng.uniform(1.0, 3.0)
                    bout_until = step + max(1, int(dur_s / tsec))
                s.dev["exploration_noise"] = babble if bout_on else 0.0
            bout_steps[bout_on] += 1
            s.observe()
            latch = s._held is None or s._policy_i % s.hold == 0
            sim_t = float(s.frames[0].sim_time)
            if latch:
                pos, quat = s.pose()
                if pending is not None:
                    elapsed = sim_t - pending["sim_t"]
                    order, q0s = pending["order"], pending["quat"]
                    for i in range(len(names)):
                        if i == gi or order[i, 8] <= 0:
                            continue
                        qt = order[i, 3:7].astype(np.float64)
                        qt = qt / np.linalg.norm(qt)
                        q0, q1 = q0s[i], quat[i]
                        d0 = H.rotation_deg_xyzw(q0, qt)
                        d1 = H.rotation_deg_xyzw(q1, qt)
                        turn = H.rotation_deg_xyzw(q0, q1)
                        result["rows"].append(dict(
                            body=b, latch=pending["latch"], step=pending["step"], src=pending["src"],
                            noise=pending["noise"], part=names[i], strength=float(order[i, 8]), d0=d0, d1=d1, turn=turn,
                            closer=bool(d1 < d0), elapsed=elapsed,
                            chance=chance_share(q0, q1, d0), cos=rotvec_cos(q0, qt, q1)))
                src = getattr(s.model, "last_action_source", None)
                noise_now = float(s.dev["exploration_noise"])
                sources[src] = sources.get(src, 0) + 1
            s.policy_act()
            if latch:
                pending = dict(order=np.array(s._held[0], dtype=np.float64), quat=quat, sim_t=sim_t,
                               src=src, noise=noise_now, latch=latches, step=int(s._policy_i - 1))
                latches += 1
            if k % 25 == 0:
                print(f"body {b} step {k} latches {latches} rows {len(result['rows'])} "
                      f"{(time.time()-t0)/(k+1):.2f}s/step", flush=True)
    finally:
        s.close()
    result["bodies"][str(b)] = dict(latches=latches, sources=sources, bout_steps={"on": bout_steps[True], "off": bout_steps[False]}, seconds=time.time() - t0,
                                    start=s.start)
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(result), encoding="utf-8")
    print("body", b, "done", result["bodies"][str(b)], flush=True)
result["seconds"] = time.time() - t_all
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(result), encoding="utf-8")
print("done", flush=True)

"""Cases 2 and 3: physics only, no model. The loop of mimo_bridge/tools/whole_body_following.py
run() (same env, same DRIVERS, same rest_order/_turn, same kp/strength/angle/hold), with the
closer-or-not count added: for each part ordered (strength > 0, gaze row excluded), is the part
closer to its ordered world orientation after exactly 25 ticks (250 ms) than at the order?
The tool's own gauge (cmd_response_slow.cos, read at ticks 26-27 as the tool does) is kept for
cross-reference with the recorded anchor."""
import os, sys, json, math, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

from mimo_bridge.tools.command_following import _turn, rest_order
from mimo_bridge.tools.whole_body_following import DRIVERS
from mimo_bridge.tools.gof_probe_harness import rotation_deg_xyzw, axis_angle_xyzw, quat_mul_xyzw

SCRATCH = Path(sys.argv[1])
TRIALS = int(sys.argv[2])
SEED = int(sys.argv[3])
OUT = SCRATCH / sys.argv[4]
KP = float(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 6.0
STRENGTH = float(sys.argv[6]) if len(sys.argv) > 6 else 0.5
ANGLE = float(sys.argv[7]) if len(sys.argv) > 7 else 20.0
ORIG = len(sys.argv) > 8 and sys.argv[8] == "orig"     # the tool exactly as written: row n-1 unordered
HOLD = 25
N_RAND = 200
crng = np.random.default_rng(SEED + 999)


def chance_share(q0, q1, d0):
    hits = 0
    for ax in crng.normal(size=(N_RAND, 3)):
        qt = quat_mul_xyzw(axis_angle_xyzw(ax, d0), q0)
        if rotation_deg_xyzw(q1, qt) < d0:
            hits += 1
    return hits / N_RAND


def xyzw(env, ids):
    return np.array([[q[1], q[2], q[3], q[0]] for q in (np.array(env.data.xquat[b], dtype=np.float64) for b in ids)])


def main():
    from mimo_bridge.env import BridgeEnv
    from mimo_bridge.body_layout import names_for
    names = list(names_for("trunk_v1"))
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    env = BridgeEnv(scene="crib", run_dir=str(SCRATCH / "scenes"), vision=False,
                    tag=f"_closer_{KP:g}_{STRENGTH:g}_{SEED}", age=24, contact_profile="mechanical_v4",
                    caregiver_seconds=0, kp=KP, body_layout="trunk_v1", cmd_horizon=HOLD)
    rows, gauge = [], []
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        env.reset()
        n = len(names)
        # whole_body_following.py uses gaze = n - 1, which in trunk_v1 is "chest" (row 25); the
        # gaze row is 23. The real gaze row is excluded here and the chest is ordered like any part.
        gaze = names.index("gaze")
        unordered = (n - 1) if ORIG else gaze
        ids = list(env.proprio.body_ids[:n])
        assert [h.body_id for h in env.decoder.handles] == [int(x) for x in env.proprio.body_ids]
        dt = float(env.dt)
        for _ in range(20):
            env.step(rest_order(env, n), None, None, render=False)
        for t in range(TRIALS):
            kind = "consistent" if t % 2 == 0 else "independent"
            if kind == "consistent":
                drive = rest_order(env, n)
                for group in DRIVERS:
                    h = group[int(rng.integers(len(group)))]
                    i = names.index(h)
                    drive[i, 3:7] = _turn(drive[i, 3:7], rng.normal(size=3), math.radians(ANGLE))
                    drive[i, 8] = STRENGTH
                for _ in range(40):
                    env.step(drive, None, None, render=False)
                target = rest_order(env, n)
                for _ in range(60):
                    env.step(rest_order(env, n), None, None, render=False)
                order = target.copy()
            else:
                order = rest_order(env, n)
                for i in range(n):
                    if i != unordered:
                        order[i, 3:7] = _turn(order[i, 3:7], rng.normal(size=3), math.radians(ANGLE))
            order[:, 8] = STRENGTH
            order[unordered, 8] = 0.0
            q0s = xyzw(env, ids)
            sim0 = float(env.data.time)
            cos_t = []
            q1s = None
            for k in range(HOLD + 2):
                out = env.step(order, None, None, render=False)
                if k == HOLD - 1:
                    q1s = xyzw(env, ids)
                    elapsed = float(env.data.time) - sim0
                cr = out.info.get("cmd_response_slow")
                if cr and cr.get("cos") is not None and k >= HOLD:
                    cos_t.append(float(cr["cos"]))
            if cos_t:
                gauge.append(dict(kind=kind, trial=t, cos=float(np.mean(cos_t))))
            for i in range(n):
                if i == gaze or order[i, 8] <= 0:
                    continue
                qt = order[i, 3:7] / np.linalg.norm(order[i, 3:7])
                d0 = rotation_deg_xyzw(q0s[i], qt)
                if math.radians(d0) < 1e-4:        # the env gauge's own skip line for a zero ask
                    continue
                d1 = rotation_deg_xyzw(q1s[i], qt)
                rows.append(dict(kind=kind, trial=t, part=names[i], d0=d0, d1=d1,
                                 turn=rotation_deg_xyzw(q0s[i], q1s[i]), closer=bool(d1 < d0),
                                 chance=chance_share(q0s[i], q1s[i], d0), elapsed=elapsed))
            for _ in range(60):
                env.step(rest_order(env, n), None, None, render=False)
            if t % 20 == 0:
                print(f"trial {t} rows {len(rows)} {time.time()-t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
    finally:
        env.close()
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(dict(kp=KP, strength=STRENGTH, angle_deg=ANGLE, hold_ticks=HOLD, seed=SEED,
                                   trials=TRIALS, dt=dt, orig=ORIG, rows=rows, gauge=gauge, seconds=time.time() - t0)),
                   encoding="utf-8")
    print("done", len(rows), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json, sys, math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

SP = Path(sys.argv[1])
MIN_RAD = 1e-4
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)


def per100(rows, key="closer"):
    return 100.0 * float(np.mean([float(r[key]) for r in rows])) if rows else None


def cluster_ci(rows, cluster_key, key="closer", reps=2000):
    groups = {}
    for r in rows:
        groups.setdefault(cluster_key(r), []).append(float(r[key]))
    g = list(groups.values())
    sums = np.array([sum(x) for x in g]); cnts = np.array([len(x) for x in g])
    idx = rng.integers(len(g), size=(reps, len(g)))
    vals = 100.0 * sums[idx].sum(1) / cnts[idx].sum(1)
    return [float(np.percentile(vals, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(vals, 97.5))], len(g)


def summary(rows, cluster_key, halves):
    rows = [r for r in rows if math.radians(r["d0"]) >= MIN_RAD]
    out = dict(closer_per_100=per100(rows), part_orders=len(rows),
               closer_count=int(sum(r["closer"] for r in rows)),
               chance_per_100=per100(rows, "chance"),
               ties=int(sum(r["d1"] == r["d0"] for r in rows)),
               ordered_distance_deg_median=float(np.median([r["d0"] for r in rows])),
               turn_in_250ms_deg_median=float(np.median([r["turn"] for r in rows])),
               distance_after_deg_median=float(np.median([r["d1"] for r in rows])))
    ci, ng = cluster_ci(rows, cluster_key)
    out["closer_per_100_95pct_interval_resampling_whole_orders"] = ci
    out["whole_orders"] = ng
    ci2, _ = cluster_ci(rows, cluster_key, "chance")
    out["chance_per_100_95pct_interval"] = ci2
    out["halves"] = {}
    for name, fn in halves.items():
        a = [r for r in rows if fn(r) == 0]; b = [r for r in rows if fn(r) == 1]
        out["halves"][name] = dict(first=per100(a), second=per100(b), n_first=len(a), n_second=len(b),
                                   chance_first=per100(a, "chance"), chance_second=per100(b, "chance"))
    # by ordered distance quartile
    d0s = np.array([r["d0"] for r in rows])
    qs = np.percentile(d0s, [25, 50, 75])
    bins = []
    edges = [0.0] + list(qs) + [1e9]
    for lo, hi in zip(edges[:-1], edges[1:]):
        x = [r for r in rows if lo <= r["d0"] < hi]
        bins.append(dict(ordered_distance_deg=[round(lo, 2), round(hi, 2) if hi < 1e8 else None], part_orders=len(x),
                         closer_per_100=per100(x), chance_per_100=per100(x, "chance"),
                         turn_deg_median=float(np.median([r["turn"] for r in x])) if x else None))
    out["by_ordered_distance_quarter"] = bins
    parts = {}
    for r in rows:
        parts.setdefault(r["part"], []).append(r)
    out["by_part"] = {p: dict(n=len(x), closer_per_100=round(per100(x), 1), chance_per_100=round(per100(x, "chance"), 1),
                              ordered_distance_deg_median=round(float(np.median([r["d0"] for r in x])), 1),
                              turn_deg_median=round(float(np.median([r["turn"] for r in x])), 1))
                      for p, x in parts.items()}
    return out, rows


res = {}
live = json.loads((SP / sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
L = live["rows"]
nb = sorted({r["body"] for r in L})
maxl = {b: max(r["latch"] for r in L if r["body"] == b) for b in nb}
half_b = set(nb[:len(nb) // 2])
s, Lf = summary(L, lambda r: (r["body"], r["latch"]),
                {"bodies_first_half_vs_second_half": lambda r: 0 if r["body"] in half_b else 1,
                 "time_first_half_vs_second_half": lambda r: 0 if r["latch"] <= maxl[r["body"]] / 2 else 1})
s["elapsed_s_values"] = sorted({round(r["elapsed"], 4) for r in L})
s["by_author"] = {}
for src in sorted({r["src"] for r in Lf}, key=str):
    x = [r for r in Lf if r["src"] == src]
    ci, ng = cluster_ci(x, lambda r: (r["body"], r["latch"]))
    s["by_author"][str(src)] = dict(closer_per_100=per100(x), part_orders=len(x), whole_orders=ng,
                                   closer_per_100_95pct_interval=ci, chance_per_100=per100(x, "chance"),
                                   ordered_distance_deg_median=float(np.median([r["d0"] for r in x])),
                                   turn_deg_median=float(np.median([r["turn"] for r in x])),
                                   strength_median=float(np.median([r["strength"] for r in x])))
s["strength_median"] = float(np.median([r["strength"] for r in Lf]))
s["bodies"] = live["bodies"]
res["live"] = s
for tag in sys.argv[3:]:
    P = json.loads((SP / tag).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    R = P["rows"]
    mt = max(r["trial"] for r in R)
    for kind in ("consistent", "independent"):
        x = [r for r in R if r["kind"] == kind]
        o, _ = summary(x, lambda r: r["trial"],
                       {"trials_first_half_vs_second_half": lambda r: 0 if r["trial"] <= mt / 2 else 1,
                        "alternate_trials": lambda r: (r["trial"] // 2) % 2})
        g = [a["cos"] for a in P["gauge"] if a["kind"] == kind]
        o["tool_gauge_cmd_response_slow_cos_mean"] = float(np.mean(g)) if g else None
        o["tool_gauge_trials"] = len(g)
        o["settings"] = dict(kp=P["kp"], strength=P["strength"], angle_deg=P["angle_deg"], hold_ticks=P["hold_ticks"],
                             seed=P["seed"], orig=P.get("orig"), elapsed_s_values=sorted({round(r["elapsed"], 4) for r in x}))
        res[f"{tag}:{kind}"] = o
print(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
